results.title: UCL Swift Launches SWIFT NID with Standard and Quick Reel Configurations
results.description: CARROLLTON, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--UCL Swift today announced the SWIFT NID, a wall-mounted network interface device (NID) designed to simplify fiber installation at residential and small-office/home-office (SOHO) locations while providing a clearly defined demarcation point between the service provider network and customer premises equipment (CPE). The SWIFT NID is available in two configurations: Standard and Quick Reel, giving network operators flexibility to select the installation approach
